subject: Skylark Systems — runway & soft-hold recommendation for dedicated GPU sizing
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runway check for Skylark late-stage — need hold recommendation

Team,

Skylark is in late-stage negotiation (SKL-2025-042). Jamie just told me procurement intends to sign within 3–4 weeks if we commit a plan for dedicated capacity sizing and a short reservation window during onboarding. Can ops confirm: do we have 8xA100-equivalent GPUs that we can earmark (soft hold) for a 21-day onboarding window starting mid-July? If so, what impact does a 21-day soft-hold have on other late-stage deals in that region (us-west)?

Key asks:
- Quick availability snapshot for July 10–31 (per-pod mapping and thermal headroom)
- Ops recommendation on soft-hold vs committed reservation for this deal (trade-offs: cost, SLA, cancellation policy)
- Any requested guardrails for a short hold (minimum notice, lead time for activation)

I copied Laura since this may need finance/discount approval depending on the proposal. Marissa — can you also attach the latest MAP and the expected initial throughput profile? Jamie asked for a simple statement we can send back to procurement.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway check for Skylark late-stage — need hold recommendation

Connor —

I pulled a quick inventory slice and attached a trimmed CSV (capacity_snapshot_q2.csv) with pod-level availability for us-west. Short summary:
- Us-west pod-3 has 10 A100-eq GPUs idle the week of July 7–14. Pod-2 shows capacity at ~65% (no free full nodes).
- Thermal headroom okay for additional 8x contiguous allocation in pod-3, but it would consume our typical burst pool for that week.

Recommendation:
- Offer a 21-day soft-hold on 8 GPUs in pod-3 starting July 10. Soft-hold = no charge; capacity is flagged in inventory and will be released automatically if deal doesn't progress to execution by day 21.
- Require a refundable activation fee or a signed MAP milestone (stage 1 payment) to convert to a firm reservation — this prevents last-minute churn.
- If Skylark needs guaranteed throughput beyond onboarding, propose a 3-month reserved window (paid) with a staggered ramp.

Risks:
- Holds reduce our available burst for other Q3 POCs — if another higher-value deal needs same dates, we may need to re-prioritize.
- If multiple soft-holds stack up, we lose scheduling flexibility.

Next steps: confirm internal approval for a 21-day soft-hold + suggested activation fee. If approved, Connor can send a templated note to Jamie with dates and MAP attachment.

Attachment: capacity_snapshot_q2.csv (pod, node_id, gpu_count, available_from, notes)

Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lu <jamie.lu@skylark-systems.com>, Resonant Procurement <procurement@resonant.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Skylark — proposed short-hold and MAP for onboarding (SKL-2025-042)

Jamie / Procurement team,

Thanks for the call earlier — we're excited about the opportunity to partner with Skylark. Per our internal availability check, we can earmark 8 GPUs in us-west (pod-3) for a 21-day onboarding window starting July 10, subject to internal approval on a hold policy.

Attached is our Mutual Action Plan (Skylark_Mutual_Action_Plan_2025.pdf) showing milestones and the onboarding acceptance criteria. To convert the soft-hold to a firm reservation we ask for either a short activation payment aligned to stage 1 of the MAP or a signed activation notice.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm you want us to place a 21-day soft-hold starting July 10 (we will communicate exact node IDs once the hold is applied).
- If you prefer a paid reservation, let us know and we will send pricing & contract addendum (Reserved Capacity Annex).
- Schedule onboarding kickoff call week of July 14 — proposed time: Tue Jul 15 10:00am PT.

Let me know which option you want to proceed with and we will lock it internally.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | San Francisco, CA
Attachment: Skylark_Mutual_Action_Plan_2025.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request — 21-day soft-hold for Skylark (impact & pricing note)

Folks,

Summary: Marissa's snapshot shows contiguous 8x A100-eq availability in pod-3 for Jul 10–31. I'm requesting an official approval to apply a 21-day soft-hold for deal SKL-2025-042. Operational details and financial trade-offs below.

Operational plan:
- Soft-hold action: flag node IDs in inventory, prevent automated allocation for non-reserved jobs, release automatically at EOD Jul 31 if not activated.
- Activation path: convert to paid reservation within 21 days via MAP milestone or activation payment.
- Owner: Ops (me) will execute hold once we have written approval from Revenue Ops/Finance.

Financial note:
- Soft-hold: no charge, but we recommend a $5k activation fee refundable upon conversion to reservation to discourage frivolous holds.
- If converted to reservation: standard reserved pricing applies; finance will calculate prorated credit for the activation fee.

Impact analysis:
- Marginal effect on burst pool for Jul 10–14; probability of conflict with other late-stage deals is low but non-zero (estimated 12% based on current pipeline).
- If we approve multiple concurrent soft-holds, we risk 7–10% degradation of our POC throughput for that week.

Request:
- Laura: please confirm approval for a one-time refundable $5k activation fee and permission to place the 21-day soft-hold. If you want, I can draft the brief for Revenue Ops to sign.

If I don't hear back by EOD today, I'll hold off until we have explicit sign-off.

Rishi Malhotra
Capacity & Planning Lead — Redwood Inference
